carmen (sales): CedarBank POC update: during interactive demo they saw TTFT spikes up to ~1.2s on short replies (30-90 tokens). Can eng swarm? Call in 25m.
kai (eng-runtime): On it. Which pool/model? Any traces or sample payloads?
carmen (sales): Hosted us-east, pool cedar-poc-eu (weird name but it's their config), model redwood-chat-medium. They attached a trace showing batch_wait_ms ~130 and kv_misses. Also a few 429s during the spike.
mohan (eng-sre): Looking at infra: autoscaler bounced one replica at 11:03 UTC -> KV shard rebalance right after. Some pods fell back to disk-backed KV causing misses. Also batch_hold_time has a tail at ~140ms.
rachel (solutions): If prompts share system prefix, KV caching helps a lot. Recommend client prefill_tokens:1 immediately. Also ask them to run the trace command so we can correlate.
kai (eng-runtime): Quick ops suggestions: 1) reduce batch_window_ms to 7ms and max_batch_size to 10 for that pool; 2) set min_replicas=2 during demo window to avoid churn; 3) enable KV prefetch for top prefixes. These should reduce TTFT at some throughput cost. Shall I push now?
carmen (sales): Please push. Also Cedar asked if Dedicated eliminates this and how pricing changes.
tessa (acct exec): Dedicated reduces noisy-neighbor churn and gives dedicated KV shards. We can offer a 6-month reserved at 15% off + 5k demo credits for POC. I'll DM numbers and include a warmup onboarding run.
quota-bot: applied 5000 demo credits to cedarbank@example.com @ 2155554335
mohan (eng-sre): Adding a pod-warmup job to prepopulate KV for their top 40 prefixes during deploy. That should remove cold-shard kv_misses after rollout.
kai (eng-runtime): Debug trace for Cedar to run and paste here: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-medium","input":"<sample>","trace":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace``` That returns batch_wait_ms, kv_hits/misses, requestId.
rachel (solutions): I'll attach SOC2 summary + retention/KMS notes and a short runbook with the suggested config snippet.
carmen (sales): They pasted one trace snippet: {"req":"r-4b7","batch_wait_ms":132,"kv_hits":1,"kv_misses":6,"model_ms":29} 
kai (eng-runtime): Confirms cold-kv + batching hold. After the rollout expect batch_wait_ms <25ms and kv_misses drop as warmup completes. If it persists, fallback: pin to quantized-small variant for demo.
tessa (acct exec): Note: lowering batch_window increases compute cost slightly; for the POC we absorb within demo credits. For production we'll model cost tradeoffs in the follow-up.
mohan (eng-sre): Roll started: cedar-poc-eu config update @ 2155554351. I also pinned min_replicas=2 for the demo window.
kai (eng-runtime): After roll, watch 95p/99p first-byte latency on the console and paste any sample traces. I can map requestId->pod logs.
carmen (sales): On call in 10m. I'll update Cedar with the config changes, the trace command, and the pricing note. Thanks team :thumbsup:
